note: The extensible arrows keep their natural width instead of stretching under their labels, and the labels float well above the arrow.
For lemmas sharing the theorem counter, TeX prints "Theorem 1" (a cleveref/amsthm quirk), but oxide prints "Lemma 1"; \cref{lem:a,thm:b} prints "Lemmas 1 and 2".
The \eval bar stays text-size, so the limits crowd against it.
\grad, \div and \curl render a plain ∇ instead of a bold one.

Renders right since the null-delimiter fix (no "CLOSE"), but every \ab formula stays unparsed: LaTeXML's \right closes its group before its delimiter, so \delclose's \aftergroup\egroup ends \mathclose before ")" (shared with Perl; upstream SYNC_STATUS row).
The \eval bar does not stretch, and the \sum limits sit beside the sign instead of under it. The "CLOSE" leak inside \eval and \order is fixed; the formula stays unparsed, as physics2__ab.
The ⋮ row of \bxmat* is empty.
\boldsymbol{\nabla} is emitted as <mo mathvariant="bold">, which browsers ignore.
The \accentset ring and the big-dot \dt collide with the top of the base letter.
\Centerstack and \Vectorstack rows are staggered instead of centred, and \stackinset sets × beside ○ instead of on top of it. This affects 26 corpus documents.
The \cancel strokes are invisible because <menclose> is not in MathML Core (upstream residual R3b).
frametitle={...} is dropped; mdframed is a stub binding, so the real package is never loaded.
Leading spaces on the first verbatim line are lost.
multicols is flattened to one column; the text itself is intact.
The tree flattens to a bulleted list "• S • NP • D …" with no SVG. There is no tree in the corpus today.
The voltage-source label floats to the left of the source.
\addplot colours (blue, red) are dropped; plain TikZ colours work. The legend layout is right since the #785 fix.
The sseqpage output is empty and no error is reported. This affects 2 corpus documents with 25 diagrams.
The Young diagrams lose their boxes, and the tableau drops entry 2. This affects 3 corpus documents.
The left parenthesis of \spalignmat, \spalignaugmat and \spalignvector does not stretch.
The table of contents is empty in all 32 memoir corpus documents; the chapter-style rules leak around a bare "Contents".
Labels are numeric ([1]) instead of alphabetic ([Har77]), and the article title is set like a book title.
